SkillRegistry port shape: Breaking change: SkillRegistry.activateFor() returns List<ActivatedSkill> (data class: name + prompt) instead of List<String> — pre-1.0, only 2 implementations, both in-repo
ActivatedSkill lives in kore-core next to the port; minimal fields (name, prompt) — extend later with default-valued fields if needed

Span attributes: kore.skill.names as OTel string-array attribute + kore.skill.count (long) + kore.skill.duration_ms (long); constants added to KoreAttrs; KoreTracer.withSpan attrs map needs a List<String> branch
kore.skill.activate span always emitted (count=0 when no match) — matches current unconditional behavior, makes no-match debuggable from traces
SkillActivated event design: One batch event per agent run: AgentEvent.SkillActivated carries the full list of activated skill names — mirrors the span, fewer bus messages
Payload: agentId: String, skillNames: List<String>, durationMs: Long — count derivable from names.size; no prompts on the bus (size + sensitivity)
Emitted only when >=1 skill matched — no-match visibility covered by the always-emitted span (count=0); keeps broker traffic lean

EventBusMetricsObserver: kore.skills.activated counter per skill name + durationMs recording; EventBusSpanObserver: explicit no-op branch (real span created in-process by AgentLoop, deriving a second would duplicate)
integrationTest task layout: Tag-filtered Test task on existing src/test source set with includeTags("integration") — no source-set move; matches CI-01 'tag-filtered' wording; shares fixtures/deps with unit tests
Zero-test guard: afterSuite/test listener tallies executed tests, throws GradleException if 0 — self-contained in build.gradle.kts, runs identically local + CI, catches a silently-empty tag filter

Decoupled from build/check lifecycle — integrationTest runs only on explicit invocation or the CI integration job; keeps ./gradlew build fast and Docker-free for contributors (mirrors existing tasks.test { excludeTags("integration") })
